2026-11-21.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.

items.text: Added the M79 grenade launcher, a new explosive weapon for players.
Introduced a convar to enable modern sprint strafing, allowing more fluid movement while sprinting.

Shoulder camera now responds more dynamically: it follows forward/backward and vertical movement without drift, adjusts distance when crouched, leans with speed changes, reacts to melee hits, and briefly pauses after hard landings.
Vehicle and mount chase cameras now have distinct profiles with smooth easing when mounting or dismounting and a configurable range for tuning.
Spectator view no longer experiences slow‑motion; it now correctly follows the target without lag.
Train tunnel rail links are prevented from spawning too close to lakes, eliminating blocked tunnels and terrain carving issues.

Fixed multiple base occlusion and deployable visibility issues, including foundation placement errors, deployables on roofs and seams, dropbox visibility through walls, and placement problems in tall rooms.

Extraction improvements: failed jobs now return cargo, ground rope physics and cable tool behavior are fixed, bow handling is steadier, and walking animations are smoother with hip turning on diagonals.
Raid entry and exit now feature a black screen with a hatch sound, and returning home after a raid places you beside the deploy point behind the summary screen.
Scrap is now kept in a central bank at the hub rather than in individual stash slots.
Engine sounds now correctly play for pooled vehicles, fixing silent or overlapping audio.

2026-11-20.summary:
### Gameplay & Combat
- Added the M79 grenade launcher, a new explosive weapon for players.
- Introduced a convar to enable modern sprint strafing, allowing more fluid movement while sprinting.

### Movement & Camera
- Shoulder camera now responds more dynamically: it follows forward/backward and vertical movement without drift, adjusts distance when crouched, leans with speed changes, reacts to melee hits, and briefly pauses after hard landings.
- Vehicle and mount chase cameras now have distinct profiles with smooth easing when mounting or dismounting and a configurable range for tuning.
- Spectator view no longer experiences slow‑motion; it now correctly follows the target without lag.

### World & Environment
- Train tunnel rail links are prevented from spawning too close to lakes, eliminating blocked tunnels and terrain carving issues.
- Fixed multiple base occlusion and deployable visibility issues, including foundation placement errors, deployables on roofs and seams, dropbox visibility through walls, and placement problems in tall rooms.

### Extraction & Raid Flow
- Extraction improvements: failed jobs now return cargo, ground rope physics and cable tool behavior are fixed, bow handling is steadier, and walking animations are smoother with hip turning on diagonals.
- Raid entry and exit now feature a black screen with a hatch sound, and returning home after a raid places you beside the deploy point behind the summary screen.

### Economy & Storage
- Scrap is now kept in a central bank at the hub rather than in individual stash slots.

### Audio & Immersion
- Engine sounds now correctly play for pooled vehicles, fixing silent or overlapping audio.

items.text: Weapon handling improvements: flamethrower fuel gauge now tracks fuel correctly, mid‑reload magazine bug fixed for smoother reloading, and Uzi turn‑loop issue resolved.
All remaining guns added and melee swings now align with the crosshair; gathering hits no longer cause camera knockback.
PT boat front turret damage and accuracy rebalanced; computer station dismount bug fixed to prevent players from getting stuck.
CH‑47 helicopter disconnect bug resolved, reducing unexpected drops, and TerrainHeightRaise objects added to underground train tunnel junctions to prevent rare terrain‑collision deaths.
Procedural generation fixes improve river handling, water pipe placement, inland spawn locations, missing train entrance, underwater flora, river terrain behavior, and source gaps.
Roadside junk piles reduced by half, room‑occluded entity sounds restored for better audio awareness, and the Seagull Trophy achievement added.
Door placement and destruction now refresh only the modified door; half‑walls place correctly, improving building stability.
Quick crafting of pies enabled with queueing, canceling, and smoother movement; large backpack size increased and burlap clothing added for raids.
Fixed visibility bugs that kept base contents hidden behind closed industrial garage doors, armored doors with open hatches, and shut ladder hatches.
Deployables now correctly detect all nearby building block changes, improving placement reliability.
Off‑center snapping issue resolved, allowing structures to snap precisely to grid points.
Patrol helicopter rockets fixed to behave correctly, restoring intended damage output.
Missions board tab now has a fixed size and can be closed with Escape or Tab for smoother navigation.
Adjusted reticle stance and camera defaults, adding a shoulder‑camera tuning panel and thirds overlay for more precise aiming.
Removed vending machines from extraction zones; players can no longer purchase items there, affecting on‑site economy.
Scouts now have a longer detection delay, provide brief investigation glimpses, and are more likely to appear over large monuments, altering scouting strategy.
Shoulder camera now aligns the barrel with the crosshair, improving line‑of‑sight consistency.

2026-11-19.summary:
### Combat & Weapons
- Weapon handling improvements: flamethrower fuel gauge now tracks fuel correctly, mid‑reload magazine bug fixed for smoother reloading, and Uzi turn‑loop issue resolved.
- All remaining guns added and melee swings now align with the crosshair; gathering hits no longer cause camera knockback.

### Vehicles & Transport
- PT boat front turret damage and accuracy rebalanced; computer station dismount bug fixed to prevent players from getting stuck.
- CH‑47 helicopter disconnect bug resolved, reducing unexpected drops, and TerrainHeightRaise objects added to underground train tunnel junctions to prevent rare terrain‑collision deaths.

### World & Environment
- Procedural generation fixes improve river handling, water pipe placement, inland spawn locations, missing train entrance, underwater flora, river terrain behavior, and source gaps.
- Roadside junk piles reduced by half, room‑occluded entity sounds restored for better audio awareness, and the Seagull Trophy achievement added.

### Base Building & Crafting
- Door placement and destruction now refresh only the modified door; half‑walls place correctly, improving building stability.
- Quick crafting of pies enabled with queueing, canceling, and smoother movement; large backpack size increased and burlap clothing added for raids.

### Base Visibility
- Fixed visibility bugs that kept base contents hidden behind closed industrial garage doors, armored doors with open hatches, and shut ladder hatches.

### Building & Deployables
- Deployables now correctly detect all nearby building block changes, improving placement reliability.
- Off‑center snapping issue resolved, allowing structures to snap precisely to grid points.

### Combat
- Patrol helicopter rockets fixed to behave correctly, restoring intended damage output.

### User Interface
- Missions board tab now has a fixed size and can be closed with Escape or Tab for smoother navigation.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Adjusted reticle stance and camera defaults, adding a shoulder‑camera tuning panel and thirds overlay for more precise aiming.
- Removed vending machines from extraction zones; players can no longer purchase items there, affecting on‑site economy.
- Scouts now have a longer detection delay, provide brief investigation glimpses, and are more likely to appear over large monuments, altering scouting strategy.
- Shoulder camera now aligns the barrel with the crosshair, improving line‑of‑sight consistency.
